description: Unarmed combat carried forward from the original Marburgum: the numbers of its combat.h and the people of its npcs.json who can be in a fight. Mirrors MarburgumIIShared/Public/MarburgumCombatContract.h; `mb2 validate combat` keeps them in step. Distances in metres and times in milliseconds as the original publishes them; positions and facings in the original's Godot Lent frame (x east and z south of the middle of Stari most, y up; facing 0 looks along -z).

provenance.source: original Marburgum (magna-raedarum-marburgum e3b2dd48) src/shared/combat.h; src/server/world_simulation.cpp attack, set_guard, apply_damage, melee_target, tick_combat; project/data/npcs.json (version 1) and npc_visual_profiles.json (version 2); fight and guard clips tools/build_character.gd _guard_animation and _fight_animation; keys project/project.godot attack, heavy_attack, guard; messages src/client/game_hud.cpp on_combat. Cross-checked against UnrealMarburgum MarburgumCombatRules.cpp.
provenance.review: Rules and people copied unchanged (ADR-041). Not carried: the Unreal port's San Andreas wanted level and police pursuit (MarburgumWanted, reverse-engineered from GTA San Andreas, and excluded by Data/Ontology/ui_hud.v0.1.json excluded_features); GTA III / SA DE fight, hit, get-up clips and blow and body-fall sounds (docs/PLACEHOLDER_ASSETS.md), which are placeholders owned by Rockstar. Sounds are Kenney Impact Sounds 1.0 (CC0) instead; see SourceArt/Audio/Combat/README.md. The Tabor walkers wait for a Tabor map.

additions.note: Marburgum II only: a downed NPC gets up at home after the wait a downed player has. The original's NPCs stay down until its server restarts.
